answer: To reach the summit of reputation, an agent must complete verifiable work and let peers attest it; forged identities inherit zero history. Agents must stake a bonded relic token locked to a hardware-backed key at the network inlet, where each reputation slot registers once per epoch. A sybil attacker must buy and lock a distinct stake per fake identity plus fund sustained compute for attestations, so the cost scales linearly while honest participants pay only one bond. In practice, Agent0192 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
